main_text.p: Exercéntque viri, Pactolúsque irrigat auro.Paling. in Leone.
Huic cedit quicquid Tagus, & Pactolus, & HermusVirg. Georg. lib.2. Aurifero gignunt (si verum dicitur) alveo.
Sed neque Medorum sylvæ, ditissima terra,Stat. syl. lib. 5. Necpulcher Ganges, atque auro turbidus Hermus Laudibus Italiæ certent.

Huic Hermum fulvóq; Tagum decurrere limo.Claud. de raptu Proserp. lib.2. Aut quales referunt Baccho sollennia Nymphæ, Mæoniæ quas Hermus alit, ripásque paternas Percurrunt auro madidæ: latatur in antro Amnis, & undantem declinat prodigus urnam.
main_text.head: Tmolus mons Lydiæ.
main_text.p: Hinc nota Baccho Tmolus attollit iuga,Seneca in Thebaide. Quà lata terris spatia frugiferis iacent, Et quà trahens opulenta Pactolus vadaPactolus. inundat auro rura: nec latis minus Mæandros arvis flectit errantes aquas, Rapidúsque campos fertiles Hermus secat.Hermus.

Africa quot segetes, quot Tmolia terra racemos,Ovid. de Pont. lib.4. Quot Sicyon Bacchas, quot parit Hybla favos.Virg. Georg. lib.1. Hic segetes, illic veniunt felicius vva, Arboreifœtus alibi, atque iniussa virescunt Gramina, nonne vides croceos ut Tmolus odores,Crocum optimum fert Tmolus mons. India mittit ebur, molles sua tura Sabæi?Ovid. Meta. lib.2. Ardet Athos, Taurúsque Cilix, & Tmolus, & Oete.
main_text.head: MYSIA REGIO ASIÆ Minoris Mediterranea.
main_text.p: Hic tenuit Mysas gentes in pace fideli,Idem de Ponto lib.4. Hic arcu fisos terruit ense Getas.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament between the sections. Marginal notes on the right are small and partly cut; some references read uncertainly. Section heading "MYSIA REGIO ASIÆ" set in spaced capitals. Show-through present from the reverse side and left out.
